autonomous_tasks.query: Evaluate whether any of the shared features (e.g., mean radius or mean area) exhibit an artificial correlation with the prediction outcome that does not align with biological or medical semantics of cancer progression.
autonomous_tasks.expected_output: A rationale for why a particular feature may be spurious—e.g., high value in all misclassifications but unrelated to actual malignancy indicators.

tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides consistent feature importance across instances, allowing identification of shared high-attribution features.
